description: The ceremony scan projection: the closed map of estateprofile.Projection fields a raw ceremony profile (melusina.estate-profile/v1, the foundation-stage release set's chain-constants-template, byte for byte) states for the estate being built, and the release publisher trust it names (releaseTrust, EstateProfileV1's ReleaseTrustV1: the publishers a foundation cut verifies the provider suite against, and which a deployable cut requires the owner-signed profile to carry unchanged). Generated by the contracts repository; the deployer carries a byte copy and its CeremonyProjectionFromRaw must reproduce every case (estate, projection and releaseTrust), extraction-only case and refusal exactly.
checkOrder: not valid UTF-8, or not exactly one strict JSON value (RFC 8259; no byte-order mark, no trailing data): ceremony-scan-projection-not-json
a duplicate object key at any depth, compared after unescaping: ceremony-scan-projection-duplicate-key
the value is not an object, or has no string member "schema" equal to ceremonyProfileSchema: ceremony-scan-projection-schema-mismatch

label, then fields in array order. Each dotted path is walked by exact own keys (no case folding): an absent key anywhere on the path is field-missing:<path>; an intermediate that is not an object, or a leaf that is not a string or breaks its kind rule, is field-malformed:<path>; a genesisHash equal to kinds.genesisHash.mainnetBetaGenesisHash is ceremony-scan-projection-mainnet-genesis-refused
then releaseTrust, in the order of releaseTrust.checkOrder (exact own keys; strings compared after unescaping; the threshold judged by its exact number text)
the first failing check is the refusal; a refusal names a path, never a value

publicKey.rule: base58 text over the Bitcoin alphabet, 32 to 44 characters, that decodes to exactly 32 bytes, is the canonical encoding of those bytes and is not 32 zero bytes

genesisHash.rule: a publicKey; the mainnet-beta genesis hash is refused by its own name

checkOrder: any member besides publisherKeys and threshold: field-malformed:releaseTrust

publisherKeys not an array of 1 to maxPublisherKeys strings, each 64 lowercase hex characters that are the canonical encoding of a prime-order Ed25519 point, in strictly ascending order (so none repeats): field-malformed:releaseTrust.publisherKeys
threshold not a JSON number written as a canonical integer (no sign, fraction, exponent or leading zero), or below 1, or above the number of publisherKeys: field-malformed:releaseTrust.threshold

extractorScope: The deployer extracts; it does not validate. refusals[] are refused identically by both languages. extractionOnly[] are extracted by the deployer and refused by the contracts repository as ceremony-scan-projection-profile-invalid, because they are not complete ceremony profiles; full validation is the contracts runner's, before any on-chain effect.
